# Highlighter Pen

> Chrome extension for annotating live webpages and exporting screenshot feedback.

## Product facts
- Free: up to 20 combined annotations per page; normal screenshots include a watermark.
- Pro: 9.99 USD one-time; unlimited annotations, watermark-free screenshots, HD PNG, visible-area PDF, Markdown feedback, local history and custom source information.
- Annotations are local to the browser, with no cross-device cloud sync. Website changes can affect restoration.
- HD enlargement cannot create missing source details. PDF is the visible area, not a full scrolling-page capture.
- Online sign-in and payment services are required for purchase and activation.
